basedOn.note: Existing adapter is stdio-only; this draft freezes the Web transport/tool contract, not a claim of current HTTP implementation. Pin current YY authority revision in W5-01 before coding.

transport.portPolicy: YY-owned free port, distinct from Local; 8178 is a candidate, not a fixed value
transport.publicRoutePolicy: YY-only endpoint; ngrok primary; Cloudflare then Secure MCP Tunnel fallback for YY only
transport.authenticationPrecondition: No private workspace data may be exposed until the chosen ChatGPT-compatible access boundary is proven; server-side workflow binding is always required.

toolInventoryPolicy.exposureInvariant: MCP tools/list exposes exactly toolInventory; no other tools are registered for @yy.

readOnlySemantics.allTools: Calls do not mutate YY business state, create execution jobs, dispatch work, or write workspace files.
readOnlySemantics.yy_open_workflow: Only resolves workflow_id through the trusted registry and opens/returns a read-only snapshot session or binding. It never creates a business task, advances a journey, reopens CLOSED, or creates an execution job.
readOnlySemantics.allowedNonBusinessEffect: An ephemeral read-session/binding may be established; it has no business-state side effect.

tools.name: yy_open_workflow

workflow_id.description: Identifier resolved by the server-side trusted workflow registry; never a filesystem path.

tools.resultData: Snapshot page as produced by the pinned YY authority; includes snapshot_id, source/payload digests, evidence_refs page, complete, omitted_sections, next_cursor.

tools.name: yy_get_snapshot
tools.resultData: Same authority snapshot page contract; supplied snapshot_id/cursor must match the current or pinned source version.

tools.name: yy_get_stage

step.description: Canonical YY step; only the values accepted by the existing authority are valid.

tools.resultData: Canonical stage identity/status/prerequisite projection from YY authority, with snapshot_id and source_digest evidence.

tools.name: yy_read_asset
tools.resultData: asset_id, section_id, content, complete, toc_complete/content_complete when applicable, omitted_sections[], next_cursor, source_version{path,bytes,sha256}, range when paged. Critical sections must be complete or return a named error.

tools.name: yy_read_evidence
tools.resultData: evidence_ref, source_kind, inferred, content, complete, omitted_sections[], next_cursor, source_version{path,bytes,sha256}, range; evidence includes snapshot_id and source_digest.

code.description: Stable error code; null on success.

resultEnvelope.successInvariant: ok=true and code=null; preserve authority-defined data/evidence fields and additive fields without Python semantic rewrites.
resultEnvelope.failureInvariant: ok=false, stable code, data/evidence are empty objects, warnings are safe messages; no stack trace, secret, private absolute path, or raw stderr reaches Web.

bridgeProtocol.response: One UTF-8 JSON object matching resultEnvelope on stdout; diagnostics only on stderr.
bridgeProtocol.authority: Pin exactly one existing YY Node read-only authority/revision in W5-01; Python transports/adapts only.
bridgeProtocol.authorityBoundary: MCP/Bridge is not YY authority. It may validate, adapt protocol, normalize transport envelopes, page, timeout, and report errors; it must not redefine journey stages, GATE_VOCAB, CAPABILITY_MAP, asset eligibility, governance, supersedes, CLOSED semantics, or validation rules.

contextAndAccessInvariants.workflowBinding: workflow_id -> server-side trusted registry -> canonical workspace root; no model-supplied disk path input
contextAndAccessInvariants.unknownBinding: Unknown workflow/workspace fails closed without returning another workspace path, workflow data, evidence, or private metadata.
contextAndAccessInvariants.pagination: Cursor binds workflow + snapshot/source digest + resource ref; source drift returns STALE_VERSION or SOURCE_CHANGED, never mixed revisions.
contextAndAccessInvariants.criticalContextCompleteness: Critical sections are never silently truncated. If any required critical section cannot be returned in full, return an explicit incomplete state or fail with CORE_CONTEXT_TOO_LARGE; do not return a plausible partial authorization/action/CLOSED statement.
contextAndAccessInvariants.criticalTextPreservation: Preserve complete authorization and allowed-action statements; never truncate a qualification such as 'before execution' while presenting the result as complete.
contextAndAccessInvariants.closedRead: Before/after state hash, journey hash, task count, workspace fingerprint must match; read calls have no write/dispatch operations.
contextAndAccessInvariants.supersedes: Historical evidence remains superseded exactly as the YY authority reports.

runtimeOwnershipInvariants.yyEndpoint: Own server.pid, tunnel.pid, config, logs, selected free port and endpoint lifecycle.
runtimeOwnershipInvariants.watchdogScope: YY watchdog and stop operations may target only a verified YY-owned process identity; they never stop or restart Local.
runtimeOwnershipInvariants.stalePid: If process is absent, clear stale YY PID record and continue startup.

deploymentGate.beforePrivateData: Prove a ChatGPT-compatible access boundary plus server-side allowlist; otherwise do not publish private workspace data.
deploymentGate.routeMapping: @local endpoint -> local port; @yy endpoint -> YY port and six-tool build identity; never route @yy to 8168.
deploymentGate.ngrokProbe: Must prove simultaneous endpoint, correct route markers, YY stop/restart isolation before formal deployment.

unverifiedItems: Production Local source root and health are not yet established; 8168 had no listener at planning-time check.
Current YY authority revision must be pinned before W5 implementation.
ngrok second endpoint/domain/agent capability is UNKNOWN until W2 probe.
ChatGPT-compatible access boundary must be proven in W8 before private data use.
Selected YY port is not fixed; 8178 is a candidate only.
